title: Wall area.
officialText:
The wall area above built-in tubs with installed shower heads and in shower compartments shall be constructed
of smooth, noncorrosive and nonabsorbent waterproof materials to a height not less than 6 feet (1829 mm) above the room floor
level, and not less than 70 inches (1778 mm) where measured from the compartment floor at the drain. Such walls shall form a
water-tight joint with each other and with either the tub, receptor or shower floor.
